data.name: Subtitle
data.value: Write your question in natural language about the team data. The assistant queries the backend tools with your session and answers with the sources it used.

data.name: EmptyState
data.value: No questions yet. For example: «Dime cuantos dias de vacaciones tiene Juan Perez.» or «Dime que tareas tiene pendiente Mauricio Cardenas.»

data.name: ErrorNotConfigured
data.value: The AI assistant is not configured. There is no provider key available in this environment; the application keeps working without AI.

data.name: ErrorRateLimited
data.value: The service is busy, try again in a few minutes.

data.name: ErrorService
data.value: Could not reach the AI service.

data.name: ErrorInvalid
data.value: Could not obtain a valid response.

data.name: ErrorRequest
data.value: The question could not be sent.

data.name: RoundsExhausted
data.value: I could not answer within the round limit.
